text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I can't fall asleep at all! Am I not tired 
enough? Even though I did my usual 
training—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No! That probably wasn't enough! In that 
case, I just gotta push my body even 
harder!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Time to start training! The voice of 
destiny says training will kill two birds 
with one stone!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Brimming with energy and heading into 
training, Epiphaneia ended up staying up 
late...
